summary: AssessmentValidationResult is a sealed class representing the result of validation checks related to assessments. It contains Boolean fields indicating specific validation outcomes.
purpose: To encapsulate validation results for assessment-related operations, indicating whether certain conditions or rules have been met during the assessment process.

fields.name: InterimWithoutFinal
fields.description: Indicates whether an interim assessment exists without a corresponding final assessment.

fields.name: InstructorsAndSupervisors
fields.description: Indicates whether all required instructors and supervisors are present for the assessment.

fields.name: AssessmentMaximumExceeded
fields.description: Indicates whether the assessment has exceeded its maximum allowed limit.

validations.name: InterimWithoutFinal
validations.description: Validation to check if an interim assessment exists without a final assessment.

validations.name: InstructorsAndSupervisors
validations.description: Validation to ensure all required instructors and supervisors are present.

validations.name: AssessmentMaximumExceeded
validations.description: Validation to check that assessment maximum is not exceeded.

conditions.condition: Interim assessment exists without a final assessment.
All required instructors and supervisors are present.

system_behavior: Returns validation results as Boolean values indicating assessment compliance.
content_gaps: No information about actors, workflows, deeper business rules, calculations, dependencies or exceptions beyond field-level validations.
